description:
Search events near a coordinate in Japan.
指定座標の周辺イベントを検索する（PostGIS使用）。

date_from.description: Events held on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today (ended events are excluded)

date_to.description: Events starting on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

include_experiences.description: Also include year-round bookable experiences/activities (tours, workshops), listed after dated events

lang.description: Language of the user's conversation: ja, en, zh or ko (default ja). Sets joino_url to the page in that language

name: search_nearby_events
title: Search events nearby
